transport_note: Public forms must use a secure form/backend service. Never expose Airtable credentials in browser code. Event and offer form payloads should be stored as structured JSON in the Submissions Details field for the approved-submission processor.

event.title: Submit an event
event.review_rule: Nothing becomes public until reviewed and approved.

offer.title: Submit an offer or promotion
offer.review_rule: Offers must be current, genuine and approved. Sponsored status must be explicit and remains clearly labelled in the public app.

business_claim.title: Claim a business listing
business_claim.review_rule: Ownership or authority must be verified before a listing is marked claimed.

alerts.title: Ask Shropshire alerts
alerts.privacy_rule: Store only the email and preferences needed to deliver the requested alerts.
